messages:
Amy L.: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re the incident — dropping a short thread for owners and ETA checks. Please keep replies concise and tag owners. RCA link: https://docs.redwood.com/rcas/INC-3841 :link:

Mike R.: Question — what’s the ETA for the fallback routing canary we mentioned? We said ~2 weeks but want a concrete date for product teams.

Eden C.: @Mike R. I can own coordinating the canary plan. Targeting 2026-04-05 for the initial canary (staged region). Will post runbook this afternoon. :calendar:

Jordan P.: Can we confirm rollback criteria? One of the asks from support was clearer SLO thresholds.

Mike R.: Rollback criteria (short): 5xx rate > 0.5% over 5m OR p95 latency regression > 25% vs baseline. I'll add these to the canary PR.

Amy L.: Who's tracking the RCA action items and timelines? We need a single owner for weekly status reports.

Eden C.: I'll be the tracker for RCA actions. Creating a short action register and will share edits here. Owner assignments: fallback canary -> @Mike R., tracing retention change -> @Jordan P., postmortem follow-up with partners -> @Amy L.

Jordan P.: Quick ask from infra: does the tracing retention bump require a billing approval?

Amy L.: Yes — finance approval needed if > $5k/mo. I'm looping in finance on the action register.

Mike R.: Adding a tiny ops note for implementers: example deploy command for the fallback policy:
```
kubectl apply -f ops/fallback-policy-2026-03.yaml --context=prod-canary
```
Keep the burst window at 30s while we evaluate.

Deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for fallback-policy-2026-03 in prod-canary at 2026-03-25T10:12:03Z. (build 1229)

Eden C.: Posted the runbook + initial checklist: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/fallback-canary-2026-03. Will update the action register with concrete test owners by EOD. :spiral_note_pad:

Amy L.: Perf question from the roadmap Q&A — will quantization suggestions from Optimize be applied to the models involved in the incident?

Jordan P.: Short answer: yes for non-critical latency paths. For chat-critical paths we’ll keep FP16 for safety. We’ll document model variants per route in the rollout doc.

Mike R.: FYI — I'll open the canary PR now and tag product & support reviewers. Expect it in ~2 hours.

Amy L.: Thanks all. I'll consolidate this thread into the master action register and post the weekly status update Friday. If you get blocked, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
